languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getEntitySetList
languageModelTools.userDescription: EntitySets or business objects retrieved from ServiceLayer metadata
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the list of EntitySets or business objects from SAP Business One ServiceLayer. If users' question is relevant to a specific EntitySet, you MUST drill down to entity details by using the tool 'WebClientUIAPI_getEntitySetDetail' to give an accurate answer; If you're not sure the EntitySet closely relevant to users' question, you can use the tool 'WebClientUIAPI_getUnbindFunctions' to check if there's any relevant function to retrieve the data.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getEntitySetDetail
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get detailed metadata for a specific EntitySet in SAP Business One ServiceLayer, including properties, keys, related functions and actions. If a property, parameter, or return type is a complex or enum or entity type, use 'WebClientUIAPI_getTypeDetail' for further details. For OData query generation, use this tool together with 'WebClientUIAPI_validateEntityProperties' to build accurate queries.

entitySet.description: The exact name of the EntitySet

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getTypeDetail
languageModelTools.userDescription: Complex or enum type metadata retrieved from ServiceLayer
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the detail of a complex type (e.g.DocumentLine) or an enum type (e.g. BoYesNoEnum) from ServiceLayer. The detail includes properties or members. For ServiceLayer OData request scenario, this tool is always used along with the tool 'WebClientUIAPI_validateComplexTypeProperties' to generate an accurate OData request payload.

typeName.description: The name of the type (complex type or enum type)

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_validateEntityProperties
languageModelTools.userDescription: Validate if a list of properties exists on the EntitySet in ServiceLayer
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validate if a list of properties exists on the EntitySet in SAP Business One ServiceLayer

entitySet.description: The exact name of the EntitySet

propertyList.description: A list of property names separated by commas

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_validateComplexTypeProperties
languageModelTools.userDescription: Validate if a list of properties exists on the complex type in ServiceLayer
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validate if a list of properties exists on the complex type in SAP Business One ServiceLayer

complexType.description: The exact name of the complex type

propertyList.description: A list of property names separated by commas

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getUnbindFunctions
languageModelTools.userDescription: Unbound OData functions and actions retrieved from ServiceLayer metadata
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get unbound OData functions and actions from SAP Business One ServiceLayer to discover additional capabilities (for example, retrieving company info or update company admin info). For detailed metadata of a specific function/action, use 'WebClientUIAPI_getFunctionDetail'.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getFunctionDetail
languageModelTools.userDescription: Detailed metadata for a specific ServiceLayer function or action
languageModelTools.displayName: Get ServiceLayer Function or Action Detail
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get detailed metadata for a specific OData function or action in SAP Business One ServiceLayer. If a parameter or return type is a complex or entity type, use 'WebClientUIAPI_getTypeDetail' for further details.

functionName.description: The exact name of the function or action

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getExposedUIAPIControls
languageModelTools.userDescription: UI controls available in Web Client UI API
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get exposed UI controls (e.g. Button, Input) available in Web Client UI API. For details about a specific control, check control's schema via the tool 'WebClientUIAPI_getControlsSchema'.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getCurrentAppInformation
languageModelTools.userDescription: Basic application information, including appProvider, appName, and modules (dialogs and views).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the basic information(e.g. appProvider, appName, a list of modules including dialogs and views) of the current Web Client UI API application in the current workspace.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getViewList
languageModelTools.userDescription: UI API base view names from view metadata.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the list of available UI API base view names from views metadata.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getViewDetail
languageModelTools.userDescription: Detailed information for one UI API base view.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get detailed metadata for a given UI API base view name from views metadata.

viewName.description: The exact name of the UI API base view

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_getSchemaFilePath
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the project-local file system path of a UI API schema file first, with the global path also returned as a fallback.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the project-local path of a UI API schema file as the preferred path, and also return the extension-global path as a fallback. Use the schemaType input with one of: Manifest, ViewLayout, Dialog, Controls, Common. The result is a JSON object with schemaType, projectLocalPath, and globalPath. Prefer projectLocalPath when working inside a UI API project, and use globalPath when the local file does not exist yet. One schema might reference another schema, for example, layout.schema.json references controls.schema.json and common.schema.json, so you can get the paths of the referenced schemas by using this tool as well.

schemaType.description: The UI API schema type whose full file path should be returned.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_generateUUID
languageModelTools.userDescription: Short UUID values for the guid property of UI API controls.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate a list of short UUIDs separated by comma as the value for UIAPI controls' guid property.

uuidCount.description: The number of UUIDs to generate

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_createApp
languageModelTools.userDescription: Low-level app generation tool. Use the "WebClient UIAPI Create App" skill workflow for app creation requests.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Low-level generation endpoint for creating a WebClient UI API application from structured payload data. For user-facing create-app intents, ALWAYS run the "webclient-uiapi-create-app" skill workflow first (intent parse, guided confirmation, final approval), and call this tool only as the final execution step after explicit user confirmation. Do not bypass the skill flow unless the user explicitly asks for direct tool usage. For each view's 'baseViewName', ALWAYS use a valid exposed UI API base view name. Keep 'appName', 'appProvider', 'moduleName', and 'viewName' in PascalCase.

appVersion.description: The application version in semantic versioning format. Default is 1.0.0.

modules.description: The modules to generate for the application.

baseViewName.description: The exposed UI API base view name, for example 'Sales Order Detail'.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_addModule
languageModelTools.userDescription: Low-level add-module tool. Use the "WebClient UIAPI Add Module" skill workflow for module-addition requests.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Low-level endpoint for adding one module to the current existing WebClient UI API application from structured payload data. For user-facing add-module intents, ALWAYS run the "webclient-uiapi-add-module" skill workflow first (intent parse, guided confirmation, final approval), and call this tool only as the final execution step after explicit user confirmation. Do not bypass the skill flow unless the user explicitly asks for direct tool usage. For each view's 'baseViewName', use a valid exposed UI API base view name.

baseViewName.description: The exposed UI API base view name, for example 'Sales Order Detail'.

languageModelTools.name: WebClientUIAPI_addView
languageModelTools.userDescription: Low-level add-view tool. Use the "WebClient UIAPI Add View" skill workflow for view-addition requests.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Low-level endpoint for adding one view to an existing module in the current WebClient UI API application from structured payload data. For user-facing add-view intents, ALWAYS run the "webclient-uiapi-add-view" skill workflow first (intent parse, guided confirmation, final approval), and call this tool only as the final execution step after explicit user confirmation. Do not bypass the skill flow unless the user explicitly asks for direct tool usage. Provide moduleName, viewName, and a valid exposed UI API baseViewName.

baseViewName.description: The exposed UI API base view name, for example 'Sales Order Detail'.
